text:
mina: quick design review: micro-toolbar for streaming replies — shows a compact 'response meter' + Stop / Regenerate. goal: less visual clutter than a persistent pill. fig: https://figma.redwood/microtoolbar

omar: +1 for less noise. wording: avoid 'tokens' in primary UI. use 'response progress' or 'budget meter'. tooltip can explain tokens.

ben: accessibility: toolbar must appear on focus (not hover-only). add aria-live region for streaming updates and clear labels for actions. avoid icons-only buttons.

a11y-bot: Automated check: ensure contrast >=4.5:1 for small text; floating toolbar should be in DOM after the response for SR users; overlay must trap focus when open.

mina: mobile behavior: tap chevron -> bottom sheet with large Stop + Regen. desktop: hover/focus expands a 3-button toolbar.

omar: prompt library tie-in: Details opens a mini panel mapping generated tokens back to prompt lines and offers shorter templates. useful for debugging long outputs.

ben: interaction notes: show overlay after 120ms hover to avoid flicker; animate expansion; Stop should be fast to hit for mid-stream cancel.

mina: next steps: ben drafts ARIA snippets, omar wires storybook prototype + analytics, i'll update figma variants and microcopy. experiment behind flag: play-microtoolbar-2026.

a11y-bot: Checklist: focusable controls, aria-live for streaming text, Esc to dismiss, keyboard shortcuts documented.
